limitations: No main merge, production deployment/migration/write, real provider, signer, key, chain call, actual account signup, messages to people or live funds.
This is an isolated financial simulation. Actor identities, seller actions and retained buyer digests are recorded facts, not authenticated sessions, signatures or proof of complete canonical reads.

Only explicit continuation, initial seller reservation and operator pause are available in v3. No resume, new funding, new enrollment/correction/payment/cancellation/dispute/release/payout/settlement command exists after continuation.

Old v1/v2 financial semantics, original fixture bytes and the existing canonical-cohort-v1 recovery format remain unchanged. Every v3 operation refuses the existing coordination namespace, even empty.

The first cohort refuses competing target-listing reservations, noncancelled target-listing wallet history and unpaired active seller wallet trades. General three-trade policy is unchanged; wider cohorts require complete bidirectional canonical/wallet identity mappings.

The new native reservation uses complete synthetic in-memory canonical facts and no canonical database writes or seller sessions. The retained initial canonical mechanics drill remains a separate pause-only fixture.
Unknown-COMMIT evidence injects a lost response after a real commit. It is not a physical network-partition test or an authenticated initial acceptance recovery protocol.

Format3 backup is wallet-only and requires a paused isolated source. Canonical/coordination namespaces are refused. A distinct authenticated combined initial-acceptance recovery contract and writer activation remain unfinished.

A future seller coordinator must derive stored web/mobile authority and explicit selling eligibility, recheck it after awaited work, own complete canonical reads, and atomically commit canonical effects, reservation, receipt and safe publication intent.
Public web/mobile routes and screens, external delivery, full trade lifecycle, real custody/provider/signing integration and independent operational/security review remain open launch requirements.
The Chromium gate is the retained standalone English/Arabic rehearsal, not a new v3 product screen or actual platform authentication flow.
Root TypeScript excludes apps/mobile and three existing test paths. No native application build, full production build, production role/migration audit or live readiness is claimed.
